reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The `metallb-bgp` integration Helm options `bgp.enabled`, `bgp.announce.podCIDR`, and `bgp.announce.loadbalancerIP` have been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Helm values under bgp.* (bgp.enabled, bgp.announce.podCIDR, bgp.announce.loadbalancerIP) no longer take effect; BGP announcements configured through these keys will not function unless migrated to bgpControlPlane options.
consequence.remediation: Remove bgp.* keys from Helm values and reconfigure BGP announcements using bgpControlPlane options as documented in the Cilium BGP control plane feature.

proposed.statement: Three Helm configuration keys for the metallb-bgp integration (bgp.enabled, bgp.announce.podCIDR, and bgp.announce.loadbalancerIP) have been removed; users must migrate to bgpControlPlane options for BGP announcements.
